constraints.description: Signing and reassessment derive identity, practice and clinical authority from verified context; caller-supplied actors cannot grant authority.

validation.validation_method: Focused host and HTTP tests plus source anchors in the current inventory.

constraints.description: Gate policy, AppServices and PostgreSQL independently refuse administrator, agent, stale revision and foreign-scope signing attempts; policy-reader outages remain availability failures rather than denials.

validation.validation_method: Task 5 and 7 acceptance receipts, current hashes and live PostgreSQL markers.

constraints.description: Signing and reassessment command results survive a lost response and React navigation; the process-scoped identity/practice/case owner retains its mutation slot until lookup, and retry or lookup creates no duplicate clinical effect.

validation.validation_method: Task 6 acceptance receipt and focused service, HTTP and hook tests.

constraints.description: Authorized reassessment retains met, gap and void as distinct states with surgeon attribution, audit and receipt records.

validation.validation_method: Task 6 and 7 reassessment receipt hashes and lifecycle markers.

constraints.description: Signing, gate affirmation and reassessment mutations do not enter PEM or local sync replay paths.

validation.validation_method: Task 8 PEM exclusion receipt and current production TypeScript import/call paths.

constraints.description: The mounted server uses restricted PostgreSQL clinical repositories and fails closed when required clinical dependencies are unavailable.

validation.validation_method: Mounted composition anchors, deployment tests and test-only memory-adapter assertions.

constraints.description: The report distinguishes mounted HTTP operations from browser hooks without reachable controls and inactive desktop wrappers without Tauri registration.

validation.validation_method: Static caller inventory over route composition, React routes/components and desktop command registration.

constraints.description: Checksummed additive migrations preserve fresh and populated upgrades, serialize publication against protected table DDL from command start, serialize approval against QA and claim truncation, and revalidate complete QA and cited-document sets under those locks.

validation.validation_method: Current source hashes and task 8 fresh/upgrade signing and reassessment receipts with complete cleanup.

constraints.description: Only applicable T0/T1 work is marked Passed; production deployment, browser rendering, Tauri IPC and physical-device behavior remain unverified.

validation.validation_method: Completion report and checklist enumerate actual commands, observed results and explicit delivery limits.

constraints.description: Manifest, constraints, persistent state, evidence inventory and generated outputs are complete and schema-valid.

validation.validation_method: Draft-07 schema validation, exact dist coverage and deterministic validate.py checks.

global_rules: Scope is RA-03 completion evidence; no new product behavior is added during refinement.
No broad phase T2, release T3, commit, deployment or publication occurs in refinement.
termination_conditions: All ten applicable constraints are satisfied and validate.py exits zero.
